correctness.rationale: For local rings Q(R)=J(R), so the defining decomposition is exactly torsion-unit lifting modulo J. Hensel lifting of the simple roots X^n-1 proves sufficiency over commutative Henselian local rings with locally finite residue field, while periodicity of the residue multiplicative group proves necessity. The Z_(p), Z_p, and cyclotomic matrix arguments were checked separately, including the reduction of Phi_{d p^s} modulo p.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The full text of arXiv:2609.19882v1 gives examples and structural lemmas but not the torsion-lifting/Henselian characterization or the stated mixed-characteristic consequences. Targeted searches using equivalent residue-field, roots-of-unity, localization, completion, p-adic, and matrix formulations found no prior statement. Standard Hensel and periodic-division-ring results are treated as prior art.

value.rationale: The result resolves a broad local/Henselian portion of the characterization problem highlighted by the source, gives a sharp Z_(p) versus Z_p phase boundary, and proves that positive-characteristic matrix permanence cannot be naively extended to mixed characteristic.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, formal verification, or a guarantee of first discovery.
